lessons.title: Letter formation & baseline control
lessons.objective: Build competition-ready understanding of letter formation & baseline control and apply it accurately to unfamiliar tasks.
lessons.core_teaching_content: Handwriting excellence is measurable through formation, spacing, alignment, size, slant, stroke control, legibility and consistency. Improvement requires repeated short practice with feedback rather than simply writing faster. Speed should increase only after writing remains readable and controlled. Focus specifically on letter formation & baseline control. Identify the key concepts, common errors, evidence or performance criteria required, and a repeatable method for improvement. Move from recognition to application: understand the task, perform it carefully, check against the stated criteria, and record the reason for any error.
examples: A Handwriting Excellence Challenge task on letter formation & baseline control should begin by identifying the exact clue, form or performance criterion being tested.
Create a new letter formation & baseline control example with a plausible distractor or common error, then explain the correct response or performance.
lessons.practical_activity: Complete a focused Handwriting Excellence Challenge activity on letter formation & baseline control using practice questions, a text, oral dialogue, puzzle, writing sample or performance sample as appropriate.
lessons.guided_practice: Work through three scaffolded tasks on letter formation & baseline control: model the first, prompt the second, and require independent performance on the third with explicit justification or self-check.
independent_practice: Complete three unfamiliar letter formation & baseline control tasks without viewing the solution first.
Create one new example and complete it using the lesson method.
Review one error or weak performance and state the correction rule.
lessons.assessment_checkpoint: Complete an eight-item Handwriting Excellence Challenge checkpoint on letter formation & baseline control; target at least six correct or meet the stated performance standard consistently.
lessons.student_task: Produce one finished Handwriting Excellence Challenge task demonstrating letter formation & baseline control and record the evidence or self-assessment used.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Coach for precise terminology, evidence and repeatable self-correction. Encourage independent performance before intervention. Suitable for self-learning.
lessons.reflection_completion: Record one strength, one recurring error and one concrete action for improving letter formation & baseline control.
lessons.daily_flow: Learn → Worked Example → Guided Practice → Independent Practice → Check → Reflect
